summary: v52bv — Tested back button on /vendor/services and Service quotes KPI tile on /vendor. Backend 5/5 pass: GET /api/v1/engagements/mine returns 401 unauth, 200 vendor-scoped (only own buyer_email), route not shadowed by /{eid}, POST /quote-request still works, /mine count increments after new quote request. Frontend authenticated flow 5/5 pass: KPI strip has 5 tiles, 'vhome-kpi-services' tile with 'Service quotes' label + briefcase icon + numeric figure + sub-line, click navigates to /vendor/services, back button shows '← Back to supplier portal' and returns to /vendor, click 'Request quote' on supplier card increments the count on return. HOWEVER, UNAUTH /vendor/services FAILS the stated spec: fresh/no-cookie load immediately redirects to /login?expired=1&next=%2Fvendor%2Fservices, so the 'Back to home' label and 21 subscription cards are never shown.

ui_bugs.issue: Unauthenticated load redirects to /login?expired=1 instead of rendering the public purchase surface. Root cause: VendorPurchase.jsx calls vendorApi.me() on mount; on 401 the global axios interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (lines 86–92) force-redirects any non-/login/non-/ path to /login. The component's .catch() runs AFTER the interceptor has already set window.location.href. Result: the services-back-btn with 'Back to home' label is unreachable for anonymous visitors, and the 21 subscription cards don't render for them.

action_items: Fix VendorPurchase.jsx vendor-detection probe: pass { _skipAuthRedirect: true } so the 401 doesn't trigger the global /login redirect. Example: vendorApi.me({ _skipAuthRedirect: true }) — matches the v52bk pattern used by useAuthSession. Without this, anonymous visitors cannot see /vendor/services at all, which contradicts the review spec ('Back to home' + grid must render on fresh unauthenticated context).
critical_code_review_comments: engagements.py: /mine correctly placed above /{eid} — good. Properly scoped to vendor['email']. Returns via _out which strips _id. OK.

VendorHomeE.jsx: load() swallows all errors in a single try/catch — if vendorApi.me() throws (expired cookie), the whole page falls back to empty state silently. Consider per-call .catch like you already do for the other APIs, OR check me() first and redirect to /vendor/login explicitly.
VendorPurchase.jsx: the vendor-detection probe uses vendorApi.me() without _skipAuthRedirect; triggers global redirect for anonymous users (see HIGH bug above).
seed_data_creation: Tests created 2 real quote_requested engagement rows via POST /api/v1/engagements/quote-request as manualvendor. These are not cleaned (vendor cannot cancel; admin-only). Current /mine count for manualvendor was 3 at end of run. Future runs will keep accumulating unless admin cancels them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After the main agent patches VendorPurchase.jsx to skip the auth redirect on the me() probe, re-run only the unauth leg: load /vendor/services with fresh context.clear_cookies(), assert services-back-btn visible with label '← Back to home', click → URL == '/', and verify PurchaseGrid cards render (e.g., product-card data-testid count > 0). The authed flow and backend are already fully validated.
